derivation: Let d = W_A - 0.5*(W_B + W_C) and S(h) = logit_A - 0.5*(logit_B + logit_C). At the final normalized hidden state immediately before the linear LM head, gradient_h S = d.

The current positive steering vector is v = d / ||d||, so adding g*v gives Delta S = g * d dot v = g*||d||. The +VECTOR condition is therefore the steepest unit-norm ascent direction for this exact scalar readout objective at that site.
SIGN_FLIP gives Delta S = -g*||d|| by the same algebra. This is a useful directionality/instrumentation control but does not by itself show a discovered semantic representation.

The current ORTHOGONAL_SAME_NORM control is explicitly constructed orthogonal to plus. Since plus is collinear with d, d dot orthogonal_control = 0 up to numerical precision. At this final linear readout site its target-score null effect is therefore designed into the geometry rather than discovered empirically.
NULL_VECTOR similarly checks implementation drift, not semantic specificity.

PERMUTED_SAME_NORM is not matched on projection onto d. In a high-dimensional hidden space it can easily have a much smaller target projection than +VECTOR, so +VECTOR beating it does not isolate a semantic mechanism.

Consequently the current adjudication rule (+VECTOR above orthogonal/permuted nuisance controls) can be satisfied by readout geometry even if no upstream population-level or globally coordinating J-Space representation has been identified.

counterhypothesis.claim: The current six controls remain valuable because they catch hook failure, sign mistakes, null drift, and gross direction non-specificity even if some expected score relations are algebraically constrained.
counterhypothesis.assessment: SUPPORTED. Reclassify them as instrumentation/readout controls rather than sufficient semantic-J-Space controls; do not remove them.

stronger_discriminator.name: INTERMEDIATE_REPRESENTATION_VECTOR_PLUS_PROJECTION_MATCHED_AND_LABEL_TRANSFER_CONTROLS
requirements: Retain the final-norm LM-head-derived vector as READOUT_ALGEBRAIC_POSITIVE_CONTROL.

Derive the candidate J-Space vector only from calibration-set intermediate residual activations, e.g. contrastive positive-minus-negative activation means; do not use LM-head rows in its construction.
Freeze layer, vector, normalization and gain before disjoint holdout evaluation.
Add WRONG_LAYER and LAYER_SHUFFLE controls to test localization rather than mere injectability.

Add a readout-projection-matched nuisance direction where feasible: match the candidate control's projection onto the declared output readout while differing in residual-space semantics, so target-logit projection alone cannot win the specificity comparison.
Add LABEL_REMAP/CONCEPT_SWAP holdouts: preserve the underlying semantic contrast while changing A/B/C or equivalent response-token mapping, so a token-row construction cannot explain transfer.
Measure off-target vocabulary/task behavior and behavior-level transfer, not only the A-vs-B/C scalar score.

Add lesion/rescue: remove or project out the preregistered intermediate direction, then restore the same bound direction at the preregistered layer; require the predicted effect ordering on unseen holdout families.

Bind source tree, dirty state, Python/Torch/Transformers build, checkpoint/tokenizer consumed identity, vector-source activation receipts, intervention layer/site, gain, endpoint and every control invocation in the exact runtime receipt.
acceptance_logic: The readout-algebraic control may pass without granting Global-J-Space credit.
A representation-derived intermediate vector must outperform appropriate nuisance controls on preregistered holdout behavior, not merely on the score used to construct or select it.
Semantic transfer must survive label remapping or an equivalent output-token change.
Wrong-layer/shuffle and lesion controls must reduce the effect in the preregistered direction; rescue must restore it.
Any failure preserves narrower direct vector-consumption evidence but blocks stronger J-Space promotion.
stronger_discriminator.falsifier: If a projection-matched nuisance or token-label remapping explains the same effect, or if the intermediate representation-derived vector lacks layer-specific lesion/rescue behavior, reject the stronger semantic/global J-Space hypothesis for this intervention family.
